unitTitle: Past Perfect Simple - Past Continuous vs Past Perfect Simple

pairsWith.noteUz: Past Perfect savol-javob, uch o'tgan zamon aralash, gaplarni moslash.

scanNote:
GRAMMAR 2, 8-UNIT MAShQLAR, 2-BET (42-bet, PDF 41). Yuqorida chapda ko'k '8'.

CHAP USTUN:
5) 'Fay's mother had to go away for a week. Look at the table below and ask and answer questions about what Fay had/hadn't done by the time her mother returned home.' JADVAL (rasmlar bilan): water the plants ✓ (sug'orgich); feed the dog ✓ (it); pay the electricity bill ✗ (lampochka); visit her grandparents ✓ (keksa er-xotin); clean her room ✗ (chelak va shvabra); do the ironing ✓ (dazmol); go to the greengrocer's ✗ (pomidor, qalampir, qulupnay). 1 A: Had Fay watered the plants? B: Yes, she had. 2-7 A: ...... B: ......

O'NG USTUN - 'Past Simple - Past Continuous - Past Perfect Simple':
6) 'Put the verbs in brackets into the past simple, past continuous or past perfect simple.' 1 A: What 1) ...... (you/do) at the weekend? B: We 2) ...... (go) to a seaside resort. We 3) ...... (stay) in a lovely guest house and we 4) ...... (have) a great time until someone 5) ...... (steal) our motorcycle. A: Oh, my goodness! 6) ...... (they/catch) the thief? B: No, he 7) ...... (drive) away before the police 8) ...... (arrive). 2 A: I 9) ...... (crash) my car last night. B: Oh, dear! How 10) ...... (you/manage) to do that? A: Well, I 11) ...... (drive) down Ford Street when a cat 12) ...... (run) in front of my car. B: What 13) ...... (happen) next? A: I 14) ...... (turn) too quickly and hit a post. B: And the cat? A: Oh, it 15) ...... (already/climb) up a tree. 3 A: Guess who I 16) ...... (run into) this morning! Bob! B: Really? Where? A: I 17) ...... (drive) to the office when I 18) ...... (see) him waiting for the bus. B: 19) ...... (you/give) him a lift? A: Yes, I did.
7) 'Match Column A to Column B to make correct sentences.' A: 1 She had finished cooking dinner 2 After Bob had packed his suitcase 3 By the time the bell rang 4 He didn't stop working 5 The plane had just left. B: a the students had already left the classroom. b until he had completed his project. c when he reached the airport. d when the guests arrived. e he called a taxi to take him to the station.

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '42'.

exercises.instructionEn: Fay's mother had to go away for a week. Look at the table below and ask and answer questions about what Fay had/hadn't done by the time her mother returned home. water the plants ✓; feed the dog ✓; pay the electricity bill ✗; visit her grandparents ✓; clean her room ✗; do the ironing ✓; go to the greengrocer's ✗.
exercises.instructionUz: Feyning onasi bir haftaga ketishga majbur bo'ldi. Jadvalga qarang va onasi qaytguncha Fey nima qilgan/qilmagani haqida savol-javob qiling. gullarni sug'orish ✓; itni boqish ✓; elektr to'lovini to'lash ✗; buvi-buvasini ziyorat qilish ✓; xonasini tozalash ✗; dazmol qilish ✓; sabzavot do'koniga borish ✗.
exercises.explanationUz:
HAD + KIM + V3? - Yes, ... had. /
  No, ... hadn't.

  ✓ → Yes, she had.
  ✗ → No, she hadn't.

  V3: watered, fed, paid, visited,
  cleaned, done, gone


⚠ 'THE ELECTRICITY BILL':

  = elektr to'lovi (hisob).


⚠ 'THE GREENGROCER'S':

  = sabzavot-meva do'koni.
exercises.exampleEn: 1 A: Had Fay watered the plants? B: Yes, she had.
exercises.exampleUz: 1 A: Fey gullarni sug'organ edimi? B: Ha.
modelAnswers: 1 A: Had Fay watered the plants? B: Yes, she had.
2 A: Had Fay fed the dog? B: Yes, she had.
3 A: Had Fay paid the electricity bill? B: No, she hadn't.
4 A: Had Fay visited her grandparents? B: Yes, she had.
5 A: Had Fay cleaned her room? B: No, she hadn't.
6 A: Had Fay done the ironing? B: Yes, she had.
7 A: Had Fay gone to the greengrocer's? B: No, she hadn't.
modelAnswersUz: 2 Fey itni boqqan edimi? - Ha. (feed → fed)
3 Fey elektr to'lovini to'lagan edimi? - Yo'q. (pay → paid)
4 Fey buvi-buvasini ziyorat qilgan edimi? - Ha.
6 Fey dazmol qilgan edimi? - Ha. (do → done)
7 Fey sabzavot do'koniga borgan edimi? - Yo'q. (go → gone)

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the past simple, past continuous or past perfect simple.
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni past simple, past continuous yoki past perfect simple shaklida qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
UCh O'TGAN ZAMON.

  PAST SIMPLE - ketma-ket / tugagan
  PAST CONTINUOUS - davom (when
    bilan uzilgan)
  PAST PERFECT - oldinroq (before,
    already)

  1-DIALOG: did you do; went;
  stayed; were having (until -
  davom); stole; Did they catch;
  had driven away (before the
  police arrived - oldinroq);
  arrived
  2-DIALOG: crashed; did you
  manage; was driving (when);
  ran; happened; turned; had
  already climbed (already)
  3-DIALOG: ran into; was driving
  (when); saw; Did you give


⚠ 'TO RUN INTO':

  = tasodifan uchratmoq.


⚠ 'A GUEST HOUSE':

  = mehmon uyi (kichik
  mehmonxona).


⚠ 'A POST':

  = ustun.

exercises.instructionUz: To'g'ri gaplar hosil qilish uchun A ustunni B ustunga moslang.
exercises.explanationUz:
PAST PERFECT + BOG'LOVChILAR.

  1 had finished cooking → d when
    the guests arrived
  2 After Bob had packed → e he
    called a taxi
  3 By the time the bell rang → a
    the students had already left
  4 didn't stop working → b until

  = chamadon yig'moq.

patterns.formula: Had + KIM + V3? — Yes, ... had. / No, ... hadn't.
patterns.exampleEn: Had Fay watered the plants? — Yes, she had.

patterns.formula: KIM + had + V3 + before + KIM + V2
patterns.exampleEn: He had driven away before the police arrived.
patterns.exampleUz: Politsiya kelishidan oldin u haydab ketgan edi.

patterns.formula: KIM + was + V-ing + when + KIM + V2
patterns.exampleEn: I was driving down Ford Street when a cat ran in front of my car.
patterns.exampleUz: Ford ko'chasida ketayotganimda mashinam oldidan mushuk yugurib o'tdi.

patterns.formula: The plane had just left when + KIM + V2
patterns.exampleEn: The plane had just left when he reached the airport.
patterns.exampleUz: U aeroportga yetib kelganda samolyot endigina uchib ketgan edi.
